command:
set -eu
sudo install -d -m 0700 /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d
sudo mv /etc/secure-volume.key /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_volume.key
sudo chmod 0600 /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_volume.key
sudo restorecon -Rv /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d /var/lib/secure-volume /srv/secure
FS_UUID=$(sudo blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/mapper/secure_volume)
printf 'secure_volume /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.luks /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/secure_volume.key luks\n' | sudo tee /etc/crypttab >/dev/null
printf 'UUID=%s /srv/secure xfs defaults 0 2\n' "$FS_UUID" | sudo tee -a /etc/fstab >/dev/null
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo mount /srv/secure
sudo sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "encrypted-volume-persistence-check" > /srv/secure/health.txt'
sudo sync
printf 'FS_UUID=%s\n' "$FS_UUID"
